table_requires: Net loss attributable to common shareholders
paragraph_requires: basic and diluted net income (loss) per share were the same for all periods presented.
resulting in the recording of a $179.0 million non-cash deemed dividend
decisions.reader_note: For 2023–2025, Precigen reports loss attributable to common shareholders as the EPS numerator. In 2025 this includes a $179 million non-cash deemed dividend arising from the Series A preferred-stock conversion; consolidated net loss is not a substitute for this numerator. Stock options, restricted and performance stock units, and warrants are excluded as anti-dilutive for the reported periods. The statement exempts shares and per-share amounts from its thousands heading, and their tags use scale zero. Reported values are retained without adding excluded instruments or combining basic and diluted denominators.

table_requires: Net loss per share of common stock, basic and diluted
paragraph_requires: (in thousands, except share and per share data)
Basic and diluted net loss per share were the same for each period presented as the inclusion of all potential shares of common stock outstanding would have been anti-dilutive.
decisions.reader_note: For 2023–2025, Varonis excludes potential shares from stock options, restricted and performance stock units, and convertible-note conversion options because their inclusion would be anti-dilutive. Basic and diluted loss per share therefore use the same reported denominator. Shares and per-share amounts are exempt from the statement’s thousands heading and use scale-zero tags. This review applies only to these USD periods; it does not reinstate the separately withheld historical AFN-per-share observations. Basic and diluted counts should not be added together.
